name: PS5 OpenGL Showcase
description: Native OpenGL graphics showcase for PS5.
author: BlackBearReloaded
release_notes:
SDK 1.0.1 is SDK 1.0.0 plus one driver fix.

Fix: binding vertex buffers now takes the new references before it drops the old ones. Mesa can hand the driver a buffer on which the driver already holds the last reference. The old order destroyed that buffer and then used it. That showed up as Assertion failed: count != 1 in ps5_set_vertex_buffers in builds with assertions, and was a use-after-free in builds without. Reported and fixed by @mihawk-99 (#3, #4), found while running Minecraft Java 26.3 with Sodium and Iris.

Testing:
- Host tests, compiler tests, the capability audit and the relocated Make/pkg-config/CMake consumer checks passed in CI.
- A test application built from this source ran a focused part of the Khronos OpenGL 4.6 suite on a PS5: 3,317 cases covering vertex buffers, vertex arrays and attributes, draw calls, transform feedback and buffer objects. Every case gave the same result as in the 1.0.0 run (3,213 Pass, 103 NotSupported, 1 compatibility warning), in one launch with no crash.
- This was not a new complete conformance run. The complete result (122,799 results, no failure) belongs to SDK 1.0.0; see docs/gl46-conformance-run.md.

These CI-built binaries have not themselves been run on a PS5. The results were not submitted to Khronos; this is not Khronos certification.

The ps5-opengl-showcase zip is the OpenGL 4.6 showcase demo app (PPSA99005), built against this SDK. Extract it and upload its PPSA99005 folder to /data/homebrew/.
